newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE Sharjah oil refinery commissioning to begin August.
newsitem.headline: UAE Sharjah oil refinery commissioning to begin August.

text.p: Commissioning of FAL Oil Co's 20,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates will start in late August, an industry source said on Tuesday.
Products from the plant, which is currently being reconstructed from a dismantled Canadian refinery, will be sold by Sharjah-based FAL Oil into Gulf, Asian and Indian subcontinent markets.
"Ninety percent of the major equipment is installed on its foundations...the ship jetty is being built and pipelines being installed," the industry source said.
Full production at the Sharjah facility is slated for 1998.
Sharjah is one of the seven members that make up the Gulf Arab state of OPEC-member United Arab Emirates (UAE).
UAE is encouraging private investment in its downstream sector and is expanding its main 135,000 bpd Ruwais refinery.
